usedFor: Emails and phone numbers posted in Slack get checked by ApexVerify.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: One address per message maps to one check, with verification type and country chosen.

watchOut: The channel trigger includes bot messages, so your own bot's posts can reach “Verify Email or Phone”.
